subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the exported `qaChannelMessageActions` API permanently define canonical `target`, `threadName`, and `message` values as winning over conflicting shipped legacy aliases?
rationale: The branch is mechanically narrow and preserves aliases, but precedence for conflicting public inputs is a lasting adapter contract rather than a purely internal repair.

options.title: Adopt canonical-first precedence
options.body: Approve canonical shared-runner fields as authoritative while retaining the legacy aliases and deprecation metadata covered by this PR.

options.title: Preserve legacy-first conflicts
options.body: Require a revised adapter contract in which explicitly supplied legacy fields win when both forms are present, despite shared-runner canonical fields.

options.title: Pause for broader action-contract guidance
options.body: Defer this PR until channel adapters have an owner-approved cross-plugin precedence policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Approve canonical shared-runner fields as authoritative while retaining the legacy aliases and deprecation metadata covered by this PR.
